companies.name: Haptik
companies.description: Haptik is a conversational AI platform that builds enterprise-grade AI agents for customer experience across chat, voice, and messaging channels. The platform supports 100+ languages across 10+ channels and serves industries including retail, fintech, healthcare, travel, and education.

companies.name: CoRover.ai
companies.description: CoRover.ai is a conversational and agentic AI platform company that builds multilingual, multi-modal AI assistants and copilots for enterprises and government organizations. The platform supports 100+ languages across text, voice, and video channels and is notable for its sovereign language model BharatGPT and CMMI Level 5 certification.

companies.name: Kapture CX
companies.description: Kapture CX is an AI-powered customer experience platform that uses agentic AI trained on over one billion real conversations to automate support workflows across voice, email, chat, and social channels. The platform serves enterprises in regulated and high-volume industries with modular self-service, agent productivity, and analytics solutions.

agents.tagline: A generative AI-powered customer experience suite that unifies AI assistants, agent co-pilots, and intelligent analytics into a single platform.
agents.description: Contakt is Haptik's LLM-first customer experience suite comprising three core components: AI Assistant, Agent Co-Pilot, and Intelligent Analytics. The AI Assistant uses generative AI to resolve customer queries by fetching information from websites, knowledge bases, and CRM/API integrations, handling both pre-sales and post-sales inquiries with personalized, context-aware responses. The Agent Co-Pilot provides human agents with real-time AI-powered chat summaries, sentiment analysis, intent identification, and suggested responses to accelerate query resolution. Intelligent Analytics delivers custom dashboards with 360-degree views of bot and agent performance metrics. The platform supports deployment across WhatsApp, Instagram Direct, Facebook Messenger, SMS, RCS, and web channels in 100+ languages, with compliance certifications including ISO, HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA, and SOC 2.

use_cases.title: Automating customer support ticket resolution across omnichannel touchpoints
empowering human agents with AI-suggested responses and real-time chat summaries
generating actionable analytics on customer satisfaction and agent performance
enabling AI-driven product discovery and purchase recommendations in e-commerce

expected_outcomes: Significant reduction in support ticket volume and agent handling time
measurable improvement in customer satisfaction (NPS) and support cost savings
increased agent productivity through AI-assisted workflows

agents.tagline: Enterprise-grade AI voice agents that handle inbound and outbound calls with sub-second latency and human-like conversation.
agents.description: Voice AI Agents is Haptik's platform for building and deploying AI-powered voice agents that automate customer phone interactions across telephone, mobile apps, and web. The platform processes speech with sub-second latency and adapts in real time to nuanced, multi-turn dialogues, moving beyond traditional scripted IVR systems. It supports customization of brand personality attributes including tone, gender, accent, and voice depth, and operates in 100+ languages and dialects. The system includes confidence-driven handover to human agents when queries exceed AI capability, along with PII protection through end-to-end encryption and compliance with GDPR, CCPA, and ISO standards.

use_cases.title: Automating inbound customer support calls with natural language understanding
conducting outbound campaigns for payment reminders, appointment confirmations, and proactive outreach
qualifying leads and scheduling appointments through conversational voice interactions

expected_outcomes: Reduction in call center operational costs through automated call handling
improved customer experience through natural, low-latency voice interactions
increased lead conversion through AI-driven outbound calling campaigns

agents.tagline: A WhatsApp-first AI agent platform that brings enterprise-grade automation to small and medium businesses.
agents.description: Interakt is Haptik's WhatsApp-native CRM, marketing, and support platform that deploys ready-to-use AI agents as "AI Employees" on WhatsApp for SMBs. Powered by large language models, these agents hold natural, human-like conversations with customers and can automate up to 80% of customer queries, with accuracy improving as the system learns over time. The platform offers a suite of pre-built AI agents for handling FAQs, qualifying leads, driving sales, and managing customer support, all accessible through WhatsApp Business. Interakt is designed to make AI agent automation accessible to service-led businesses like clinics, schools, real estate firms, salons, and cafes.

use_cases.title: Automating patient care reminders and appointment scheduling for healthcare providers via WhatsApp
qualifying real estate leads and managing property inquiries through conversational AI
driving retail sales with AI-powered product recommendations and order management on WhatsApp
handling customer FAQs and post-purchase support for service businesses

expected_outcomes: 20-25% increase in lead-to-sale conversions
30-40% reduction in manual support costs
significant expansion of customer reach through WhatsApp-native engagement

agents.tagline: An omnichannel live agent workspace with built-in AI co-pilot that augments human agents with real-time intelligence.
agents.description: Smart Agent Chat is Haptik's unified agent workspace that combines live chat management with AI co-pilot capabilities to help human agents handle customer interactions more efficiently. The platform provides a single interface across multiple communication channels with real-time chat summaries, sentiment analysis, and AI-generated response suggestions for consistent, high-quality customer interactions. It includes administrative controls for role and permission management, PII masking for data protection, automated SLA monitoring with alerts, and comprehensive analytics covering chat statistics, missed chats, agent concurrency, and SLA performance. The system connects to major CRM and support platforms via webhooks for real-time data synchronization.

use_cases.title: Providing human agents with AI-suggested responses and chat summaries to reduce average handling time
managing omnichannel customer conversations through a unified agent workspace
monitoring SLA compliance and agent performance in real time with automated alerts

expected_outcomes: Reduced average handling time per agent through AI-powered response suggestions
improved customer satisfaction through consistent, sentiment-aware interactions
enhanced operational visibility through real-time SLA and performance analytics

agents.tagline: India's sovereign generative AI platform powering multilingual enterprise virtual assistants across text, voice, and video.
agents.description: BharatGPT is CoRover.ai's indigenous large language model and no-code/low-code AI studio that enables enterprises to build and deploy multilingual virtual assistants in minutes. The platform supports 14+ Indian languages for voice and 22+ languages for text, with omni-channel deployment across ChatBots, VoiceBots, VideoBots, IVR Bots, WhatsApp, Signal, SMS, email, and social media. It features multi-intent recognition with contextual awareness, integrated payment gateways, Aadhar-based KYC authentication, document-to-text conversion, sentiment analysis, and real-time analytics dashboards. The platform uses a multi-layered NLP approach combining deep learning with generative AI, supervised learning, and context-based auto-suggestion to reduce GPU overhead while maintaining accuracy.

use_cases.title: Automated multilingual customer support across channels for banks and insurers
citizen services and grievance handling for government departments
AI-powered ticket booking and travel assistance
intelligent self-service portals for healthcare and education institutions

expected_outcomes: Up to 70% reduction in customer support costs through automated multilingual interactions
significant increase in customer engagement and self-service resolution rates
rapid deployment of new AI-powered use cases in hours via no-code platform

agents.tagline: A secure generative AI copilot for enterprise information retrieval powered by RAG and BharatGPT.
agents.description: CoroAssist is CoRover.ai's enterprise copilot that functions as a secure generative AI information retrieval system built on an LLM-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework. It pulls real-time, role-based information from diverse enterprise sources including websites, documents, videos, ERP/CRM systems, and APIs, delivering contextual answers with proper source references. The system is designed to minimize hallucinations by grounding responses in verified, up-to-date data sources, and supports deployment in less than a day using industry-specific RAG configurations. CoroAssist operates across 22+ Indian languages and is built to mitigate reputational, compliance, and financial risks in regulated industries.

use_cases.title: Secure information retrieval for banking compliance and regulatory queries
enterprise knowledge management across distributed document repositories
real-time decision support for healthcare providers accessing patient protocols
governance and audit trail maintenance for compliance-heavy organizations

expected_outcomes: Faster and more accurate enterprise information retrieval with reduced hallucination risk
improved compliance and governance through transparent source-referenced AI responses

agents.tagline: A fully offline, on-device AI appliance for enterprises requiring air-gapped data sovereignty and secure local inference.
agents.description: BharatGPT DeskAI Appliance is a compact, on-device AI system that operates entirely without internet connectivity, ensuring all data processing and inference remain local and secure. Built on NVIDIA's Grace Blackwell architecture, the appliance comes pre-installed with NVIDIA DGX OS Software Stack and is bundled with CoRover's BharatGPT Mini foundational small language model with 534 million parameters supporting 14 Indic languages. It can be deployed on NVIDIA GB10 systems and can be custom-trained for domain-specific use cases in defense, BFSI, and public sector environments. The appliance addresses the critical enterprise need for secure AI compute without cloud dependency.

use_cases.title: Offline AI inference for defense and classified government operations
secure on-premises banking AI for institutions with strict data residency requirements
air-gapped enterprise knowledge assistants in regulated industries
edge AI deployment in low-connectivity environments

expected_outcomes: Complete data sovereignty with zero cloud dependency for sensitive AI workloads
secure AI deployment in air-gapped and low-infrastructure environments without compromising multilingual capabilities

agents.tagline: An AI-powered conversational grievance management system that connects citizens directly with government officials via WhatsApp.
agents.description: eSevak is CoRover.ai's AI-powered grievance management chatbot built on the BharatGPT platform, designed for government and public sector organizations. It enables citizens to submit grievances through WhatsApp, which are automatically categorized by relevance and routed to the appropriate department heads for resolution. Every action in the grievance lifecycle, including forwarding, responses, and official comments, triggers instant alerts to the citizen concerned, ensuring full transparency. The system leverages CoRover's multilingual conversational AI capabilities to serve citizens in their local languages, removing language barriers in public service delivery.

transparent government service delivery with real-time citizen notifications

expected_outcomes: Faster grievance resolution through automated routing and real-time alerts

agents.tagline: AI-powered self-service that auto-resolves up to 90% of customer queries across every digital channel.
agents.description: Self Serve 2.0 is Kapture's customer-facing AI agent platform powered by vertical LLMs with industry-specific training. It deploys autonomous AI agents across web, mobile, WhatsApp, Instagram, email, and social media channels to handle customer inquiries without human intervention. The platform uses anticipatory AI to analyze customer data and predict potential issues before they escalate. It integrates with customer data platforms to deliver personalized, context-aware responses and provides seamless human handoff when queries exceed the AI's resolution scope.

agents.tagline: Unified AI-powered agent console that frees up 60% of agent capacity through real-time AI assistance and smart automation.
agents.description: Agent Suite is Kapture's unified workspace for human support agents, combining AI co-pilot capabilities, advanced ticketing, and Customer 360 views into a single console. The embedded AI Co-pilot delivers real-time next-best-action recommendations, interaction summaries, and knowledge base suggestions during live conversations to accelerate resolution. It supports multi-channel operations across voice, email, chat, WhatsApp, and social media with consistent context carry-over between channels.

agents.tagline: Low-latency voice AI agents that handle inbound and outbound calls with identity verification and autonomous task completion.
agents.description: Kapture's AI Voice Agents are autonomous voice-based AI systems designed for both inbound and outbound customer service calls. They handle routine call types including identity verification, account inquiries, payment processing, and service requests with low-latency natural language processing. The agents can be deployed in under ten minutes using a no-code configuration interface, allowing enterprises to scale voice support rapidly. When conversations exceed the AI's capabilities, the system performs contextual handoff to human agents with full conversation history preserved.
